it now points to `/plugin` - Fixed an emoji that a link starts inside wrapping one column too wide, which hid it in question previews and turned tables into lists - Fixed worktree isolation refusing to create or resume worktrees under git 2.56 or later when a stray `.git` file points at a directory that doesn't exist - Fixed a cloud session's cost and usage restarting from zero after the session resumed in a new process - Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches failing with "bad object refs/heads" in sessions that reuse a checkout stored in git's reftable format - Windows: Fixed every file write being refused or asked about for projects on exFAT or FAT32 drives, including in sessions started with `--plugin-dir` - Improved startup time with many plugins enabled: plugin command and agent files now take far fewer file system calls to load, most of all on Windows - Improved auto mode with the server-side classifier: a conversation too long for the safety check is now compacted, instead of every checked tool call being denied - Improved the message when a background session reopened from another folder has no LLM gateway: it now says why, instead of "Not logged in" - Changed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions with no permission mode to start in `default` mode on third-party providers, with telemetry off or on a fresh install; `--permission-mode auto` keeps auto - Changed fork subagents (`subagent_type: "fork"`) to be on by default in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code, as they already are in the terminal; `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` turns them off, and `claude mcp serve` never offers them - Changed the desktop app and VS Code to always run the main conversation's subagents in the background, as the terminal does, rather than let Claude choose; a subagent's own Agent calls in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, the desktop app and VS Code now run in the foreground by default - Changed the `← for agents` footer hint to hide 10 seconds after a session opens; the count of agents waiting on you still shows - Changed where the Claude in Chrome instructions sit in the system prompt so that new conversations can read them from the shared prompt cache - Changed prompt and agent hooks so that at most 12 of one event run at a time; the rest wait their turn - Changed the message shown when your organization's policy turns off `/feedback`: it now points to GitHub issues instead of an organization admin - [VSCode] Fixed text after an unclosed code block in a list showing as plain text while a reply streams, then turning into code - [VSCode] Fixed MCP server sign-in from the panel opening a broken authorization page when the server URL contains a query string - [VSCode] Fixed the `@browser` banner saying "Browser connected" when no browser with the Claude extension can be reached - [Cloud sessions] Added a banner on a routine's page that says why its last run didn't start, such as your organization reaching its limit on concurrent cloud sessions - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Rewind to here" failing on every message except the newest in cloud sessions; self-hosted runners need Claude Code v2.1.246 or later - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the pull request status bar in cloud sessions flipping a pull request with merge conflicts back to ready while GitHub rechecked it - [Cloud sessions] Fixed routine runs showing as Completed after their cloud session stopped unexpectedly, and as Cancelled when archived before they started, instead of failed - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the diff view in cloud sessions missing changes or failing to load after the session's GitHub repository was renamed or moved - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a scheduled routine run that failed partway being run again from the start an hour or more later, which could repeat work such as posting the same report twice - [Cloud sessions] Fixed an open cloud session sometimes not showing messages sent from another device until you reloaded the page or clicked away and back - [Cloud sessions] Improved the error shown when a cloud session fails to start: it now says "Connection lost" or "Server error" instead of "Something went wrong" - [Remote Control] Fixed a subagent's pane spinning forever in a Remote Control session after your computer goes offline; it now says Remote Control is disconnected - [Claude Tag] Fixed "is thinking…" staying up under a mention in a Slack channel or DM after Claude answered it by editing one of its earlier messages - [Claude Tag] Fixed URLs in code blocks under a numbered or bulleted step of Claude's Slack replies being wrapped in angle brackets, which broke copied commands - [Claude Tag] Fixed HEIC, SVG, TIFF and BMP images attached in Slack never reaching Claude; they now arrive as files in its working files, like other file types - [Claude Tag] Fixed new channel managers losing access to Claude in Slack in organizations that restrict Claude Tag by role; the manager role now also grants Claude Tag in Slack - [Claude Tag] Fixed custom connectors whose MCP servers share one host showing as a single connector in Claude Tag admin settings; each server is now its own connector - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first - [Claude Tag] Fixed direct messages with Claude on a Slack Enterprise Grid ignoring Slack's workspace dropdown; they now run under the connected workspace you last opened Claude in - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack's notice for a channel's monthly spend limit saying a channel manager can raise it; it now names an organization owner and links the usage page - [Claude Tag] Fixed links in Claude's Slack replies absorbing the closing bold or italic marks, or full-width punctuation, right after them, which broke the link and the formatting - [Claude Tag] Improved repository search in Claude Tag admin settings to cover up to 100 connected GitHub accounts and find private repositories past the first 5,000 of a GitHub App install - [Claude Tag] Improved Add place in Claude Tag admin settings to list a channel you type or paste right away, instead of only after your organization's full channel list has loaded - [Claude Tag] Improved Add > Domain on a workspace's or channel's page in Claude Tag admin settings to be available once that page loads, not only after every channel has loaded - [Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to organize Claude's access into four tabs: Bundles, Connectors, Skills and plugins, and Channels - [Claude Tag] Changed the Roles page in organization settings to group the roles created for Claude Tag channel managers in a collapsed section below your organization's own roles - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review setup not resuming after you leave to connect GitHub; back in admin settings, it now reopens at the repository picker

item.title: v2.1.301
item.description: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting - Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the `claude-api` skill, including setting up trace destinations with the `ant` CLI - Added the `%` motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y - Added `rows` to a mod's `Input`: a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line - Added `classifier_verdict` and `permission_mode` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules - Added `classifier_category` to OpenTelemetry `tool_decision` events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1` - Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a `WorktreeCreate` hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits - Fixed the `fable` (and `best`) model alias erroring on the Anthropic API when the newest Fable model is not available to your organization: Claude Code now retries once on the previous Fable model - Fixed a misleading "Please run /login" error when a full disk keeps the login from being refreshed; the error now names the disk and says to delete files - Fixed Grep and Glob reporting no matches when the search program failed unexpectedly before returning any results; they now return an error saying the search failed - Fixed workflow agents sometimes skipping their step, and the run still reporting success, after reading the harness note that their task text carries no user authority - Fixed artifact updates being refused where a PreToolUse hook covers Edit or Write; Claude now edits the file and then republishes instead of changing it in the publish call - Fixed skills and commands with very many or very long argument names stalling for seconds when invoked; only the first 64 names, each up to 64 characters, are now filled in - Fixed skills, commands and hooks using very large amounts of memory when their arguments fill many placeholders - Fixed stray characters such as `>0q` covering the folder trust prompt, and `>4m` before the shell prompt at exit, in terminals built on VTE older than 0.53 such as MATE Terminal on RHEL 8 - Fixed stray `GOK` text appearing in the prompt at startup in some versions of iTerm2 - Fixed switching to a model whose name contains `application-inference-profile` running your `awsAuthRefresh` command and delaying model-switch hooks when the provider is not Bedrock - Fixed sign-in refresh timeouts and unexpected sign-outs after a short command such as `claude auth status` or `claude plugin list` exited in the middle of a token refresh - Fixed a tool call cut off by a message sent mid-turn during its permission check being reported to the model as rejected by the user - Fixed a case where switching to a model with a smaller context window could spend usage credits on a summary by the previous model without asking first - Fixed conversations being compacted over and over, on a model you didn't pick, behind an LLM gateway whose responses name a different model than the one requested - Fixed vim mode sometimes staying in INSERT after Escape on a slow or busy machine - Fixed Esc discarding a typed AskUserQuestion answer in vim mode: the free-text field now supports vim NORMAL mode, and Esc cancels only from NORMAL - Fixed the Read tool reading binary files such as .xlsm, .parquet, .epub and .heic as text - Fixed a Markdown table with only a header row drawing nothing when too wide for the terminal, including in plans on the plan approval card - Fixed the /claude-api skill saying CMEK external-key endpoints aren't available on Claude Platform on AWS - Fixed skills no longer being listed to the model after using `/rewind` - Fixed the compaction row in a resumed session offering ctrl+o for history that is not loaded; it now says where the earlier messages are saved, and also shows in fullscreen - Fixed the "new task? /clear to save tokens" hint coming back right after you interrupt a response - Fixed the permission prompt for a plugin or skill hook's `ask` decision not showing which plugin or skill the hook comes from - Fixed `/diff` not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories when one of its git checks timed out or failed - Fixed workflow scripts asking for permission or being refused when read, edited or re-run after a Bash `cd` in the same session - Fixed dim text on the dark ANSI theme and 16-color terminals: faint inside filled boxes, not faint under selection and search highlights, and list descriptions dimmed like other secondary text - Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions - Fullscreen mode: Fixed `/compact` and auto-compact briefly freezing the UI while the visible transcript is rebuilt - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions started from Slack being unable to find or attach a repository when managed settings restrict MCP servers; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep those tools off - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions being reported as having a deleted source branch, and not retried, when an unrelated setup or session failure quoted git's missing-ref wording - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the log promising a retry of a failed or declined session release for a session that is ending; repeated failures now show a count - Windows: Fixed stopped background PowerShell commands missing the closing `[killed]` line in their output file - Improved switching to a model with a smaller context window: a conversation too long for the new model is now summarized by the previous model first - Improved rendering performance while a long-running subagent works: its progress trail now updates incrementally instead of being reprocessed in full on every render - Improved artifacts: pages Claude writes now paint the band above a sticky header, so scrolled text no longer shows there in the mobile apps - Improved mods: in VS Code and the desktop and mobile apps, a tree drawn above the question dialog can now hold Markdown and up to 48 rows; the terminal keeps 12 plain rows - Changed a mod hook's `.catch` handler to run only when the hook throws or times out; events raised beneath the hook's own calls now skip that hook without asking its `.catch` - Changed a mod's `$.env.set` to resolve with `{}` once the variable is set or unset, or with `{ deny }` saying why when the write is not made - [VSCode] Added LaTeX math rendering in Claude's responses, including `$$` and multi-line `\[ … \]` blocks and inline `$…$` and `\(…\)` math - [VSCode] Added a "Get more usage" link to the usage-limit banner for Pro and Max plans in the VS Code and JetBrains panels - [VSCode] Fixed a conversation that crashes or freezes the panel being reopened on every reload - [VSCode] Fixed the chat panel slowing down during long thinking: it no longer re-parses the whole thinking text on every update - [VSCode] Fixed diagnostics showing "[object Object]" instead of the rule code (e.g. MD013) for some language servers - [VSCode] Fixed the native dictation audio module being loaded, to check microphone permission, where dictation is not offered (non-claude.ai sign-ins, remote windows)

item.title: v2.1.300
item.description: - Added `virtualText` to a mod's prompt decorations: text drawn in the prompt box that never enters the draft or the submitted prompt - Added `cache_creation_5m_tokens` and `cache_creation_1h_tokens` to the OpenTelemetry `api_request` event, splitting cache writes by lifetime - Added `$.ui.view({ agentId })` for mods: shows an agent's transcript in the main view when you ask, and `$.ui.view({})` goes back - Added a `dir` prop on a mod's `Text` for right-to-left text: on Windows and in VS Code's terminal its rows read in that direction and sit flush right - Added `/advisor` on Claude Platform on AWS; no advisor runs until you pick one with `/advisor`, `advisorModel` or `--advisor`, and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` turns it off - Added OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic-convention attributes to trace spans, such as `gen_ai.provider.name`, `gen_ai.conversation.id`, `gen_ai.tool.name` and `error.type` - Added support for rewriting a workflow agent's `prompt` and `model` in the `agent.spawn` mod hook, which could only refuse workflow agents before - Added the `prompt.change` mod hook, raised when the prompt box's text changes without a typed edit: a recalled history entry, a clear, an undo, or a plugin's fill - Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude that an organization policy blocked a host when the session's own network settings did - Fixed `/autocompact` warning about high token usage when you choose a smaller auto-compact window - Fixed SessionEnd hooks sometimes not running when you exit while a background command is still running - Fixed `claude --help` naming a removed tool in its description of `--restricted` - Fixed `claude agents` not refreshing any pull request's status when the data for one of them came back incomplete - Fixed Claude being told a background agent was lost, not resumable, after a cloud session's container was replaced, when the agent had already been resumed once - Fixed subagents you had typed messages to disappearing from `/tasks` shortly after finishing, leaving no way back to the conversation - Fixed a completed parent agent dropping off the breadcrumb (its child shown re-rooted at top level) while you were viewing the child - Fixed the agents view taking a typed word such as "up", "down" or "escape" for that key when input arrived in a burst, which could move the peek mid-reply or clear a draft - Fixed automatic tool search (`ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto`) turning off part-way through a conversation, for example while MCP servers reconnect after a resume - Fixed a login refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID` leaving the refused organization's token stored, or live after `/login` - Fixed the diff view in Claude Desktop and Remote Control sessions not noticing a conflicted cherry-pick or revert in reftable repositories - Fixed the Artifact tool's verbose and ctrl+o line reading `Artifact("(unprintable path)")` while a call's input arrives; its row now shows "Waiting…" and "Running…" as Bash's does - Fixed the first transcript entry written after resuming a session being lost when a crash had cut the transcript's last line short - Fixed `/branch` dropping messages, and `claude purge` skipping subfolder projects, when they contain a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Fixed plugin `WorktreeCreate` and `WorktreeRemove` hooks not running when Claude Code starts with `--worktree` (not yet with `--tmux`) - Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` in repositories using reftable ref storage - Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being recorded as typed in the OpenTelemetry `user_prompt` event and interaction span, and in session title requests - Fixed a note meant for Claude about mod hot-reloading appearing in the transcript as if you had typed it - Fixed agent hooks ignoring their `model`: aliases like `haiku` now resolve, a subagent's model no longer overrides it, and an unavailable model falls back to the caller's instead of allowing the action - Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's - Fixed the branch showing as ".invalid" and `--worktree` failing to reopen a worktree in repositories using git's reftable ref storage - Fixed Claude naming files in the session scratchpad by a bare filename or relative path instead of their full path - Fixed `claude remote-control` servers giving up on renewing their connection after a brief sign-in error, such as a locked keychain; they now retry, and warn when you need to run `claude /login` - Fixed `--worktree` failing in a worktree of a bare repository when origin's default branch can't be fetched; the fallback base is now the current checkout's HEAD, not the main repository's - Fixed starting Claude Code in a VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop integrated terminal launching the editor's command-line tool twice to check for the extension; it now launches it once - Fixed a mod's `prompt.edit` hook not being raised for a newline entered with the `chat:newline` keybinding (Ctrl+J, or a rebound Enter) - Fixed a conversation failing on every turn with a 400 error when the API rejected an MCP tool's input schema; Claude Code now sends that tool without parameters for the rest of the conversation - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing the recent messages a compaction had kept, when the compaction followed a reply cut at the output token limit (compactions from this version on) - Fixed Claude not being told about an MCP server's tools and instructions until its next tool call, when the server finished connecting after a compaction - Fixed Remote Control sessions being marked stopped while still running, on a computer serving several sessions at once - Fixed resuming a headless or Agent SDK session losing its compaction summary or bringing back pre-compaction history, when the compaction followed a retried or unfinished reply in the same turn - Fixed Claude polling a background command's output file or sleeping while it runs - Fixed feature flags and staged rollouts staying stale behind a TLS-inspecting proxy whose certificate is trusted only through the OS certificate store - Fixed `claude daemon stop --any` printing "stopped" while a stuck background service kept running: it now waits, force-kills the service, and says so with exit 1 if it is still there - Fixed `claude daemon stop` exiting with no output, and leaving sessions listed as running, when telemetry is turned off - Fixed Write, Edit and NotebookEdit in Cowork cloud sessions reporting success for a path on your own computer, where the file never arrived - Fixed Claude searching for deferred tools already loaded earlier in the conversation when a session resumes a history that never listed them - Fixed secondary (dim) text looking the same as normal text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals - Fixed cloud sessions hanging 5 minutes per turn when the organization's policy can't be read; the turn now ends promptly and says why - Fixed a cloud session sometimes running an already answered message a second time after the session restarted during a long reply - Self-hosted runner: Fixed the runner and orchestrator freezing (no polls, `/healthz` or `SIGTERM` shutdown) while nobody reads their output; logs keep the latest 256 KiB and count drops (not on Windows) - Improved WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions to tell Claude that a page failed moments ago instead of fetching it again - Improved mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: Claude scans a mod's files for keys before opening them, and asks before scanning a folder outside the project - Improved the note Claude 3 models get about an @-mentioned PDF, so they less often answer without reading it - Improved artifact updates: Claude now applies a small change and republishes the artifact in one call, and makes larger edits and republishes within a single response - Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST` sessions to ignore CA-bundle, tool-proxy, git TLS and git config variables like `SSL_CERT_FILE` in settings; under Claude Desktop, only in project settings - Changed exit to force-kill background commands still running 1.5 seconds after being asked to stop; in fullscreen mode they could previously be left running - Changed Claude Desktop's Code tab to apply managed settings when `forceLoginGatewayUrl` names an Anthropic-operated gateway that serves the session's hostname; that gateway must be reachable at start - Changed `claude gateway` to stop at start, naming the key, on a `desktop:` policy key that Claude Desktop cannot use from a gateway, where it earlier started with a warning - Changed large requests to api.anthropic.com to use gzip compression even when telemetry is disabled; set `CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0` to turn it off - Changed the `claude-api` skill to leave Managed Agents sessions in place unless you ask to archive or delete them - Changed background sessions to resume a carried workflow through the Workflow tool's approval instead of running it from the handoff file - Changed local session transcripts to also record each API request's system prompt, tools and parameters, so a transcript you choose to share can reproduce a request exactly - Changed the `/sandbox` mode options to read "Sandbox commands" instead of "Sandbox BashTool" - Changed `PermissionRequest` hooks in Cowork cloud sessions: a `setMode` update in a hook's allow is now ignored; the rest of the approval still applies - Changed hooks: `updatedInput` from PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks is now validated like Claude's own input: unknown keys are dropped, and input the tool rejects denies the call - Removed the `--sandbox` and `--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control`, which had no effect; passing either now exits with an error. Set `sandbox.enabled` in settings to sandbox sessions - [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.attachSelection` setting to stop text selected in the editor from being added to your messages - [VSCode] Fixed fast mode staying on after usage credits ran out, which made each request be refused and re-sent; it now turns off until you turn it back on, with an error notice - [VSCode] Fixed the Thinking toggle switching to Off on models that always think; the toggle is no longer shown for those models - [VSCode] Fixed "Edit prompt" on a flagged message opening the file or command menu over the restored prompt; Enter now sends it as written - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file onto the prompt on Windows inserting an unreadable `/c:/…` path instead of a mention relative to the working directory - [VSCode] Fixed changes to VS Code's chat font size settings needing a window reload or being undone by a theme change; diffs and the plan preview now follow them too - [VSCode] Fixed "Resume session" and tabs restored after a reload opening an empty new conversation instead of one that had moved into a git worktree - [VSCode] Fixed ↑ then Enter on a recalled slash command running it without its arguments; the command and file menus no longer open over a recalled prompt until you edit it - [VSCode] Fixed Shift+dragging a file from the Explorer or an editor tab onto the prompt inserting nothing in WSL, SSH and Dev Container windows - [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Alt+F toggling Focus view instead of opening Find in the Explorer, other tree views, or the Debug Console on Windows and Linux - [VSCode] Fixed the check for sessions open in other windows or terminals creating extra processes on macOS: it now starts `/bin/ps` directly instead of searching PATH for `ps` on every check - [VSCode] Windows: Fixed a conversation showing "still open somewhere else" after a crash or power loss, when Windows had since restarted and given the old process ID to another program - [Cloud sessions] Fixed "Allow for this task" missing from Cowork's approval prompts for connector tools where an organization turns off "Always allow" (regression in 2.1.292) - [Cloud sessions] Fixed most commands in the / menu losing their descriptions in cloud sessions once you sent a second message - [Remote Control] Fixed the diff view in Remote Control sessions on claude.ai and the desktop app showing deleted and renamed files as modified; requires Claude Code v2.1.296 or later on your machine - [Claude Tag] Added support for Slack Connect channels: an Owner or Claude Tag admin can let Claude in Slack answer in channels shared with another organization; it's off by default - [Claude Tag] Added a private Allow once / Deny card in Slack threads for connector actions that need your approval, so Claude asks instead of refusing; others only see that it's waiting on you - [Claude Tag] Added support for Slack voice clips in Claude in Slack: Claude reads Slack's transcript of a clip when Slack has one - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack not answering another app that tags it in a thread under a message Claude itself posted to the channel - [Claude Tag] Changed access bundles an admin attached to a Slack channel to keep applying once the channel becomes a Slack Connect channel, with no need to remove and re-attach them - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review ignoring `@claude review` comments from people with write access whose GitHub organization membership is private; their comments now start a review - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review's "paused for this repository" comment sending admins to Code Review settings; it now says who can fix it and links the Git providers page

item.title: v2.1.299
item.description: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS` environment variable: Claude gets the paths of `@` file mentions to read with its file tools, not the files' contents - Added idle compaction in the terminal: a 200K+ token conversation left idle for about 54 minutes is compacted before its one-hour prompt cache expires, so your next message doesn't reprocess it all - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS` to change idle compaction's 200K-token minimum; `"idleCompaction": false` in settings.json turns it off. Both need v2.1.290 or later - Added `$.prompt.media` so a `prompt.submit` hook of a mod installed by managed settings can read the bytes of an image or document attached to the prompt - Added `$.session.identity()` for mods installed by managed settings: how the session is signed in, and its organization and email when managed `forceLoginOrgUUID` lists that organization - Added `size`, `weight`, `mono` and `tabular` to a mod's `Text` and named spacing steps (`xs` to `xl`) to its `Box`; `bold` is deprecated in favor of `weight` - Added `--shutdown-drain-sec` to `claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator`: on SIGTERM it stops polling and gives the poll in flight and running spawn hooks up to that many seconds to finish - Added the skill's frontmatter, source, plugin name and file path to what a mod's `skill.prompt` hook receives - Added `/effort` and `/fast` in agent view to set what new sessions start with; a bare `/model`, `/effort` or `/fast` there now opens a picker - Added a "safe mode" line to the agents view peek panel for background sessions started with `--safe-mode` - Added a one-time note when plan mode won't ask before most edits or commands because bypass permissions is available - Added `--disallow-tools` and a `disallowed_tools` case field to `claude plugin eval` to keep specific built-in tools, such as Agent, out of eval runs - Added support for turning off the attribution block in Claude Desktop's Code tab: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` in the `env` of a Claude apps gateway's `code` policy - Added a field to the attribution block in Claude Code sessions behind a Claude apps gateway; remove the block with `CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0` - Added a `queue` door to the `session.append` mod hook, so a mod can make the transcript's queue records differ from the prompt as sent - Added a note in `/plugin` and `claude plugin validate` naming a mod's hooks that are skipped where an organization manages Claude Code - Added `/usage` warnings for max effort, workflows, always-on context and large tool results - Fixed the error for a denied cloud session, which could point to the wrong organization when a key from `apiKeyHelper` was in use - Fixed sessions on a gateway-specific model name behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` ending with "Prompt is too long · automatic compaction failed" near 200K tokens instead of sending the request - Fixed a mod that submits a prompt at the end of every turn keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, `--max-budget-usd`, an interrupt, or the end of the host's conversation - Fixed cloud sessions sometimes showing the model's follow-up text after a tool group's one-line label - Fixed the Write and Edit tools creating a mod in a session's mods folder without asking in accept-edits mode when the config directory's path has no `.claude` in it - Fixed installed mods that kept running in an open session after being turned off remotely; they now unload between turns - Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions failing on a message stopped while its `UserPromptSubmit` or mod `prompt.submit` hooks were still running (regression in 2.1.296) - Fixed an agent teammate started without a description keeping part of a credential from its prompt in the task description shown for it - Fixed the claude.ai view of a Remote Control or cloud session freezing when a large batch of events could not finish uploading over a slow connection - Fixed a sandboxed shell command being able to write into a `--plugin-dir` folder, whose code Claude Code reloads and runs outside the sandbox - Fixed memory growth under heavy debug logging (`--debug`, `--debug-file`), and a hang on exit when the debug log is on a disk or network mount that stops accepting writes - Fixed memory growing without bound when debug output goes to stderr and the parent process stops reading it - Fixed rm prompts on shell `-c` scripts that don't run `rm`. An rm built at run time in a script Claude Code can't read no longer prompts unless `CLAUDE_CODE_STRICT_INLINE_SHELL_RM_PROMPT=1` - Fixed double-clicking a word in an expanded transcript row in fullscreen mode collapsing the row instead of selecting the word - Fixed `claude mcp list`, `claude doctor` and `/status` reporting an empty `.mcp.json` as invalid - Fixed `/btw` jumping the transcript to the bottom when asked while scrolled up in fullscreen - Fixed sandboxed commands failing on WSL2 with `bwrap: Can't mkdir /mnt/c/Program Files/ClaudeCode` when the sandbox can write to the Windows drive - Fixed scheduled wakeups (ScheduleWakeup) not firing while a background task was running in Agent SDK, IDE and `claude remote-control` sessions - Fixed a mod's `prompt.submit` rewrite being silently dropped, sending the prompt as typed, for some prompts with a pasted image or an image that can't be read - Fixed a Remote Control prompt being lost when another queued prompt in the same batch failed to deliver - Fixed a Remote Control prompt that had passed its hooks being dropped from prompt history when Stop interrupted the next queued prompt's hook - Fixed sign-in, MCP servers and project trust appearing lost on Linux after a sandboxed command left an empty `.config.json` in the config directory - Fixed `/sandbox` reporting success when its setting could not be saved because the project folder is not writable; it now says nothing changed and why - Fixed SDK and headless sessions staying in auto mode after the host switched to a model that doesn't support auto mode - Fixed MCP servers named `constructor` or `prototype` in an MCP config never being connected - Fixed tools of an MCP server named `constructor` or `toString` asking for permission in auto mode and bypass permissions mode - Fixed a spurious "synced[0] commands path not found" plugin error at startup when another Claude Code process had just updated a claude.ai-synced plugin - Fixed the Artifact tool advising a retry when a publish that requests connectors or other access was refused by the server or a proxy (HTTP 403); it now says so and what to tell the user - Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying on an old account plugin after a plugin reload that timed out or a restart that reused a recent sync - Fixed document blocks being dropped from your own message sent while Claude is working - Fixed Claude in Chrome asking for permission while no browser is connected; it now says the extension is not connected - Fixed the fullscreen "Update installed" notice being hidden behind the idle "/clear to save tokens" hint; it now shows beside the hint - Fixed a mod hook, with or without a `.catch`, being run again without end when it waits on another mod's noun that does its work outside the call - Fixed the Claude apps gateway serving models that a policy's `availableModelsMatch: exact` or `deniedModels` blocks; it now answers 400 and leaves them out of its model lists - Fixed the server-managed settings request to Anthropic carrying a third-party gateway's API key when a managed settings file sets `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` - Fixed streams through a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` being aborted after 180 seconds with no data arriving; they now wait 300 seconds, whether or not feature flags are loaded - Fixed a mod's `tool.describe` or `prompt.section` answer that changed after `$.ui.invalidate` never reaching Claude; the new answer is now sent on the next turn - Fixed a settings file being ignored when `enabledMcpjsonServers` or `disabledMcpjsonServers` held a single server name (letters, digits, - or _) as a plain string - Fixed `claude plugin test` pausing a hook's time budget while a served `$` method it had called kept making `$` calls after answering - Fixed high memory use after resuming a cloud or Remote Control session that had run many subagents - Fixed plugin hooks being skipped when they pass a very deeply nested tool input or message on with next() - Fixed a value a mod's hook passes to `next()`, returns, or sends to a `$` method being refused whole when one of its getters throws a `RangeError`; now only that key is refused - Fixed `/usage`, the approaching-limit warning (terminal and VS Code) and the status line sometimes showing more than 100% used (anthropics/claude-code#92238) - Fixed wrapped text mixing CJK or emoji with Latin words losing its last line or leaving a blank row at some terminal widths - Fixed a cloud session sometimes ignoring the answer to a permission prompt or a question when the answer was given while the session's worker was being replaced - Fixed bold, italic and other nested text styles running over table borders or being lost on wrapped rows - Fixed Cowork cloud sessions running the old version of an account plugin changed, removed or disabled from another device until the session restarted - Fixed deny and ask rules for an MCP server (`mcp__<server>`) not applying when the server's normalized name contains a double underscore - Fixed long conversations losing newly attached images on every turn after one oversized image was refused by the API - Fixed the `plugin_loaded` telemetry event reporting `has_hooks` as false for plugins whose hooks are a hooks module, built-in plugins included - Fixed images attached while Claude is working (VS Code, desktop app, SDK) being sent at full size, which led to repeated image errors in long conversations - Fixed the image coordinate hint being missing or slightly off for large near-square images on newer models - Fixed feature flag, startup, fast mode, profile and feedback requests to Anthropic carrying the API key configured for a third-party gateway (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`); Anthropic API keys are still sent - Fixed a mod's hot reload ignoring a fix saved right after a failed reload; saving a mod file without changing it no longer reloads the mod - Fixed mods loaded from source files being refused when a hook hands `$` to a function declaration imported from another file of the mod - Fixed a regression in 2.1.296 where cloud and headless sessions could run an approved tool call twice if a new message arrived as the session resumed after a restart - Fixed scheduled tasks being announced for the wrong minute: the scheduling tools now report each job's actual next run time - Fixed mods' hooks being handed values with `__proto__` keys silently removed, which could skip a `tool.check` guard on a tool call another mod made - Fixed `claude -p` saying nothing when a settings file fails validation: text-output runs now list the file and the invalid entry on stderr - Fixed long pastes in terminals without bracketed paste losing all text after an invisible control character, such as a mis-decoded curly quote - Fixed managed settings and organization policy not being fetched when the stored login's plan was changed locally on machines whose MDM or managed-settings file sets `forceLoginOrgUUID` - Fixed MCP connections over HTTP hanging for 30 seconds and failing when a server never ends the body of its reply to a notification (anthropics/claude-code#99014) - Fixed MCP servers added to a running headless or SDK session being connected before some policy checks ran; a blocked server is now reported as failed without being contacted - Fixed `claude mcp list`, `claude mcp get` and subagent MCP servers starting a server that a policy check blocks; it is now reported as blocked without being started - Fixed `/reload-plugins` not loading a plugin installed from another terminal a moment earlier - Fixed blank rows appearing under CJK and emoji text squeezed into a one-cell column, as in a very narrow terminal - Fixed text cut in the middle beside wide characters leaving a cell unused or being cut twice, and an emoji vanishing where a color changed inside it - Fixed bare mode notices in background sessions telling you to restart without `--bare`, which keeps the mode; they now name `/stop` and `claude --resume`, as safe mode ones do - Fixed `←` not saying why it stayed put over a queued message while Remote Control is on - Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `304`, `204` or `205` response that declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit - Fixed `/config` push notification toggles sending your account the previous setting instead of the one you just chose - Fixed a cloud session leaving a reply unfinished when its worker was replaced just after the reply hit the output token limit - Fixed Read failing on PDF page ranges in remote sessions on Linux that run without elevated privileges - Fixed Enter answering a question or permission prompt that had been held back while you typed an unsent message - Fixed a file attached to a message in a remote session being left out when its download stalled part way; the download is now tried again - Fixed queued prompts sent as content blocks over `--input-format stream-json` running together without a line break when merged into one turn - Fixed self-hosted runner sessions shutting down MCP servers added through an `--exec-path` wrapper's own `--mcp-config` when connectors change mid-session - Fixed `claude plugin eval` passing runs that the API refused: a run that ends on an API error now scores 0 without grading and makes the suite exit 1 - Fixed permission prompts cutting off or wrapping too early when the reason text contains keycap or joined emoji - Fixed `forceLoginOrgUUID` and `forceLoginMethod` from MDM or the managed-settings file being hidden or replaced by server-managed settings - Fixed `--bare` sessions leaving out an MCP server named `constructor` or `prototype` that `--channels` asked for - Fixed resuming a conversation from before `/clear` reattaching to the Remote Control session of the conversation after it - Fixed a prompt starting with `/`, sent with the Agent SDK's `verbatimPrompts` option, running as a slash command when `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-ran it after a restart - Fixed background sessions started with `--safe-mode` silently leaving safe mode when the session was woken or restarted - Fixed scheduled tasks and loops firing again after every turn, or firing early, during the repeated hour when daylight saving time ends - Fixed the diff view listing a new file whose name begins or ends with a space under the wrong name - Fixed MCP tool calls in headless and SDK sessions sometimes failing or running twice when a background reconnect closed the connection they were running on - Fixed `/btw` side questions in non-interactive sessions not being cancelled when the session ends, and running a second time when the same request arrived again mid-run - Fixed sandboxed commands on macOS being able to read or write a denied path by its real location when the denied path passes through a symlink - Fixed sandbox `denyRead` and `allowRead` globs with braces, parentheses or backslashes in a folder's name being read differently by Claude Code's settings checks than by the sandbox - Fixed sandbox glob `allowRead` and `allowWrite` entries not being re-checked when the directory they start from is replaced by a symlink - Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting some awk programs the isolation guard should refuse - Fixed `claude mcp add <name> -- <command> --background` being started as a background session - Fixed a prompt or reply of `--bg` or `--background` to a background session being taken for the flag, which could start new sessions over and over instead of delivering it - Fixed a custom slash command's embedded shell line running twice when a newer message interrupted the command while its prompt was being checked - Fixed `--worktree` sessions leaving a folder behind in `.git/worktrees` in repositories using git's reftable ref storage - Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` sessions using Anthropic-managed git showing tracked files as staged deletions when starting in a reused clone whose remote is still empty - Fixed Ultracode not being announced to scheduled tasks and other delivered headless turns when `ultracode` is on in settings - Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in, token refresh and sign-out not sending configured `headers`/`headersHelper` values, which broke servers behind an authenticating proxy - Fixed the Artifact tool reporting a spurious one-line difference against the live page, and refusing the publish, when a large page with a line break after `<head>` is published again unchanged - Fixed `$.ui.open` reporting a mod's pane as placed in sessions where no surface draws it, such as Claude Code for VS Code and `claude -p` - Fixed the `agent.spawn` mod hook not running when a finished subagent or a killed teammate is resumed: the hook's event now carries `resume`, and a mod can refuse it - Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting a mod's `$.state` references when `plugin.json` has no `types` key and the contract is at `./types/index.d.ts` - Fixed a mod's `dimColor` text looking the same as plain text under the dark ANSI theme and on 16-color terminals - Fixed plan mode running a write (an MCP tool's, a file's, a shell command's) that a `PreToolUse` hook or a mod's `tool.check` hook allowed - Fixed background subagents in auto mode sometimes sending their final report twice, once as the result and once as a message - Fixed `SendMessage` not finding a subagent by name after the CLI restarted and resumed the session (names given before the last compaction still need the agent ID) - Fixed replies cut off at the output token limit ending the turn silently, with no retry or error, after a request fell back to non-streaming mode - Fixed Read garbling UTF-16LE files with a byte-order mark, and Write dropping byte-order marks or silently converting Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK or UTF-16BE files to UTF-8 (now refused) - Fixed cloud sessions sometimes leaving a message unanswered when the worker was replaced right after a compaction - Fixed cloud sessions and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` sometimes answering a finished turn again after a restart, when a tool ended the turn and a skill loaded in the same step - Fixed photos sent over Remote Control being dropped when their copy could not be saved on your computer; Claude now still sees the photo - Fixed files sent over Remote Control sometimes not arriving in long-running sessions - Fixed files of 30 to 35 MiB sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session not arriving - Fixed a user-installed mod's `$.env.set` changing the environment or shell prefix that command hooks from managed settings start with - Windows: Fixed the process-liveness check leaving orphaned PowerShell processes behind on busy machines until memory ran out - Windows: Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks that set no shell failing open when Git for Windows isn't installed; a guard that fails now blocks the call - Windows: Fixed Bash commands failing with "command not found" for a whole session when Git Bash did not report its PATH at startup - Self-hosted runner: Improved what `setup` and `doctor` say when the runner's machine has no git credentials - Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions that wrote output before their first turn being left with no release timer, ignoring `--retire-at` and delaying shutdown - Improved the error shown when a cloud session is refused because your claude.ai login was rejected or has expired: it now tells you to sign in again with `claude auth login` - Improved enforcement of managed permission rules, managed hooks and organization MCP tool names against user-installed mods - Improved memory and disk use when PDFs are @-mentioned: their bytes are no longer kept in the session transcript - Improved sandboxed Bash on Linux: Esc and Ctrl-C now work while wildcard read rules are being expanded for a command - Improved the startup warning for an unrecognized model ID: it is now one short line under the welcome banner with a docs link, instead of a long raw message - Improved the plugin-authoring skill's steps for sharing a mod: Claude asks public or private and checks the files before creating a GitHub repository - Improved the Skill tool's "Unknown skill" error to suggest a skill's listed name when Claude wrongly adds the `anthropic-skills:` prefix to it - Improved `/reload-skills` to say it re-sends the full skill list to Claude, which is how to get skills back after compaction - Improved the error shown when a worktree cannot be created because its base commit does not resolve: it now says how the lookup ended and the likely reasons, such as a repository without a commit - Improved the error for creating a worktree at a bare-repository layout's root: it now explains the layout instead of an unrelated git error - Improved artifact watching: a local session can now watch up to 25 published artifacts at once, up from 10 - Improved background agent notifications: they now say when an agent is only waiting on its own background work, got a message too late for its result, or was stopped by a usage limit - Changed plugin hooks and workflow scripts to refuse values they hand back that nest deeper than 28,000 levels, with an error naming the limit (workflow scripts allowed 100,000) - Changed actions a plugin hook can block to be refused, not let through, when the hook cannot be handed them or cannot hand back its answer; a tool that already ran has its result withheld - Changed requests to claude.ai's connector proxy and to Anthropic-hosted MCP servers to no longer follow HTTP redirects; redirects by a connector's own server are unaffected - Changed MCP requests in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions to no longer follow HTTP redirects from the session's MCP proxy - Changed skill and command loading: one whose file or folder name has hidden, direction-changing or blank-like characters, `<` or `>` is no longer offered until renamed; such a `name:` is ignored - Changed `ui.render` trees in `claude plugin test`: each mod's Box or Text root now carries `part: { plugin }` naming the mod, so exact-tree assertions must include it - Changed WebFetch page reads to pick their effort as web searches do: the caller's level on the caller's own model, otherwise the level settings give the small model - Changed `claude plugin test` to fail a call to a mod's served `$` method that has not answered within ten seconds, as a session does - Changed MCP allow rules to reach only the server they name: `mcp__a` no longer allows a server named `a__b` or `a_`; write `mcp__<server>__*` with the server's whole normalized name - Changed agent `tools:` lists to take only the named MCP server's tools; list a server whose name contains `__` as `mcp__<whole name>__*` - Changed Claude in Chrome in Cowork cloud sessions outside auto mode: an approved-site action the safety classifier flags now asks you instead of being refused, unless managed settings apply - Changed cloud session and Remote Control MCP connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out - Changed MCP tool descriptions and server instructions from Anthropic's first-party MCP servers at `api.anthropic.com` to reach Claude in full instead of being cut at 4,096 characters - Changed auto mode in Cowork cloud sessions: a `PermissionRequest` hook can no longer approve shell commands or subagents; those prompts wait or are denied - Changed the resume command printed at exit: it names the session by its ID and no longer by its name, so that nothing in a session name can run when the line is pasted - Changed the resume command printed at exit of a worktree session: it uses `-w` and `-r` if the long flags do not fit the terminal. If neither fits a kept worktree, rows above it say where to run it - Changed `/btw` side questions in non-interactive sessions to return a timeout error when still unanswered after 11 minutes - Changed `UserPromptSubmit` hooks to run before a skill or custom slash command expands, so a hook that blocks the prompt now also stops its embedded shell commands - Changed a skill's own front-matter `UserPromptSubmit` hook to first run on the prompt after the one that invokes the skill - Changed the `turn.start` mod hook to also hear subagents' and teammates' turns, not only the main loop's; tell them apart by `e.agentId` (absent on the main loop) - Changed the errors shown when `/ultrareview` can't upload a repository to stop suggesting `git add .`, which could stage or commit untracked files such as `.env` - Changed the cyber safeguard notice to no longer ask people to apply to the Cyber Verification Program - [VSCode] Fixed an unsent prompt and its attachments being lost when switching to another session and back - [VSCode] Fixed unused blank chats keeping a background Claude process running after starting a new conversation - [VSCode] Fixed the mic button showing an internal error message when you are signed out of claude.ai; it now offers to sign you in - [VSCode] Improved startup time in workspaces without a Python environment by starting Claude while the Python extension loads - [VSCode] Improved startup: the model picker and slash command menu now fill in right away in a new window on a folder you've opened before - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a memory spike that could crash a session when many of its existing output files were re-sent to it at once - [Cloud sessions] Fixed saving an edited routine silently moving it to a different environment when its own had been deleted or wasn't in the list; the routine now keeps its environment - [Cloud sessions] Fixed Sessions search in a self-hosted environment's admin details finding nothing when you paste the session ID from a session's link - [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Sessions and Runners lists in a self-hosted environment's admin details saying the list is empty when a search just has no matches - [Cloud sessions] Improved the deploy command shown when you create a self-hosted environment or environment key: it shows in full, wraps between arguments, and has a visible copy button - [Cloud sessions] Changed deleting a self-hosted environment to turn off its routines right away, with the reason shown on each routine, instead of leaving their runs to fail - [Remote Control] Fixed Remote Control sessions whose computer can't be reached still appearing to send your messages; your text now stays in the box and Send is off until it reconnects - [Claude Tag] Added the ability for Claude in Slack to delete a canvas it created in a channel when someone asks it to - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack staying silent on untagged posts that a channel's own instructions tell it to answer, such as posts that tag someone else, in channels with guests - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack reporting a reply to another channel's thread as posted when it isn't a member there; it now says the reply wasn't delivered and how to fix that - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes ending a turn without posting its answer when a self-hosted runner's image has no python3 - [Claude Tag] Changed how Claude in Slack corrects a message it got wrong: it edits the message in place and adds a short "Edited" note instead of striking through the old text - [Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to join channels with more than 100 members quietly, with no intro message - [Code Review] Fixed Code Review's monthly spend-limit comment and check-run card sending admins to Claude Code settings; they now link the Usage page, where that limit is set

item.title: v2.1.296
item.description: - Added a `code` key to the Claude apps gateway's `managed.policies[]`: the same settings as `cli`, also applied in Claude Desktop's Code tab; beside `desktop`, it turns on Claude Desktop's gateway mode - Added `autoCompactWindow` to subagent frontmatter and `--agents` definitions, so a subagent can auto-compact earlier than the main conversation's window - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL` to run every workflow agent on one model while other subagents keep theirs - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_OVERLOADED_RETRY_MAX_DELAY_MS` environment variable to set a longer maximum delay for the backoff when retrying an overloaded (529) request - Added a note in `/plugin` on a plugin whose hooks are left out because another enabled plugin has the same name - Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room - Fixed managed-settings `PreToolUse` hooks that deny a tool call with `"continue": false`, and managed `prompt` hooks that block one, refusing the call but not ending the turn - Fixed PostToolUse hooks in managed settings not applying `updatedMCPToolOutput` in some sessions - Fixed headless sessions starting a folder's `.mcp.json` or plugin MCP server that was switched off for that folder, after changing directory or reloading plugins - Fixed a Claude apps gateway that serves `allowedProviders` with `"gateway"` locking out laptops that name that gateway in user settings - Fixed a saved Claude apps gateway sign-in being ignored on machines whose managed settings set `forceLoginMethod` to `gateway` with no `forceLoginGatewayUrl` (regression in 2.1.295) - Fixed `--teleport` opening an empty conversation when the session's history could not be read - Fixed token counts for Haiku 5.5 and other models that take only adaptive thinking, which failed behind some gateways and were counted with budget thinking elsewhere - Fixed resumed subagents being told that the user rejected a tool call that a session shutdown had interrupted - Fixed hook output being altered when it contained text resembling a plugin hint tag - Fixed secret redaction in shared transcripts and debug logs missing some values that follow a key with no value, including in JSON written inside a shell string - Fixed a stray `52;c;…` escape sequence printed on screen after copying in older VTE-based terminals such as MATE Terminal - Fixed toasts and notifications waiting unseen for as long as the `/diff` panel or dialog was open - Fixed Esc or an interrupt during a `UserPromptSubmit` hook or a mod's `prompt.submit` hook ending headless sessions, clearing the typed prompt, or letting the unchecked prompt through - Fixed SessionStart hooks of a plugin loaded after a headless session starts being skipped when a different plugin with the same name, or another spelling of it, had already run - Fixed `claude self-hosted-runner` printing misleading errors when registration is refused: it now names the org admin setting, or says a restarted on-demand runner needs a fresh work order - Fixed a self-hosted runner session's git fetch, pull and push failing while another session of the same repository starts on a runner with `--capacity` above 1 - Fixed workflow scripts silently truncating results, agent options and other values nested deeper than about 20,000 levels, and deeply nested results writing huge task output files - Fixed a plugin's served `$` methods running in the main session's working directory instead of the calling agent's, and ignoring the turn their calling hook holds - Fixed `$.agent.register` succeeding from a mod's hook that was still running after the mod was reloaded or removed; the call is now refused - Fixed `$.http.fetch` in mods refusing a `HEAD` request when the response declares a `Content-Length` over the 4 MiB body limit - Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add`, `marketplace update` and `plugin install` failing with an internal error for a marketplace named like `constructor`; `add` now refuses such names clearly - Fixed a plugin secret named `constructor` or `prototype` being deleted by the next save of that plugin's options - Fixed cloud sessions skipping auto mode's checks on Claude in Chrome actions that a saved permission allows when their feature flags had not loaded - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a finished turn after a restart when an MCP tool result had ended that turn - Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving some commands that assign the `BASH_ARGV0` shell variable and then use it; these now prompt for approval - Fixed Edit and NotebookEdit replacing every non-ASCII character in files that are not valid UTF-8 (Windows-1252, Shift-JIS, GBK); such edits are now refused - Fixed a prompt sent just after `←` being run twice, once unseen in the foreground, when the background service was slow to answer - Fixed a prompt sent while SessionStart hooks were still running vanishing when `←` moved the session to the background; it is still not sent, but `↑` now brings it back - Fixed a late-loading plugin's SessionStart hook output reaching the new conversation after `/clear` in headless sessions - Fixed PowerShell commands not seeing variables that hooks write to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE (when the file holds only plain assignments) - Fixed Claude calling cloud sessions non-interactive and suggesting `/mcp` or `claude mcp` when an MCP server needs authentication - Fixed `/code-review` ending on a raw JSON array in cloud sessions, the Agent SDK and IDE integrations; the findings now print as a numbered list - Fixed auto mode occasionally refusing one update to your own artifact, saying its sharing had changed when it had not - Fixed skills synced from claude.ai never finishing their install, and being downloaded again at every sync, when several sessions share a config directory - Fixed a plugin synced from claude.ai being disabled when the marketplace dependency it declares was also synced from claude.ai - Fixed a startup hang on macOS when plugin paths copied from a Linux machine pointed under /home - Fixed the Workflow tool refusing script files with CRLF line endings, such as files checked out on Windows - Fixed OpenTelemetry `tool_result` events missing `git_commit_id` after `git commit -q` or `git -C <dir> commit` - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping a message from the saved transcript when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Fixed `claude purge` leaving a prompt in the history file when its text held a Unicode line or paragraph separator (U+2028, U+2029) - Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands longer than about 1 KB always asking for permission, so allow rules and read-only detection now apply up to 32 KB - Windows: Fixed stdio MCP servers being force-killed at shutdown; stdin now closes first and the process tree is killed only if the server is still running after 300 ms - Windows: Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub `owner/repo` plugin sources on machines with no GitHub SSH key; the clone is now retried over HTTPS - Windows: Fixed `rm -rf /c/Users/<name>` in Git Bash not asking in bypass permissions mode - Improved fullscreen mode: the link under the mouse pointer is now underlined to show it can be opened - Improved transcript toggle (ctrl+o) responsiveness in code-heavy conversations by caching syntax-highlighted code blocks - Improved Claude Desktop's Code tab behind a Claude apps gateway: when a session can't start, including on a machine not set up for the gateway's `code` settings, the reason shows as a reply - Improved the errors for a refused cloud session: they now say why your organization's policy couldn't be loaded, and name an API key or auth token that overrides your claude.ai login - Improved `--debug` output to name unrecognized frontmatter fields in custom agent files, with a hint for likely typos - Improved auto mode: a tool call that wasn't run because auto mode's check had no usable answer now shows as a dim "Not run" row instead of a red error - Improved `--debug` output for hooks: command hooks on tool calls, prompts, SessionStart and Stop now log their command, plugin, outcome and duration when they finish, so a slow hook is identifiable - Improved `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC`: a large transcript file is no longer rewritten when that would free under 10% of it - Updated `/cost`, the status line, `--max-budget-usd` and the SDK's cost figures to price Sonnet 5.5 cache reads at $0.10 per million tokens (was $0.20) - Updated the bundled dataviz skill: lighter violet for the seventh series in light mode, softer primary text in dark mode, and compact y-axis labels like 1K - Changed the default limit on MCP tool descriptions sent up front and on MCP server instructions from 2,048 to 4,096 characters - Changed `←`: a turn or `!` command started while the session moves to the background is now stopped instead of finishing out of sight - [VSCode] Fixed `claudeCode.spinnerVerbs` missing from the extension's settings, so settings.json now completes and validates it; a malformed value no longer breaks the chat panel - [VSCode] Changed Claude in Chrome to ask before browser actions in every session, including one connected with `@browser`, as the terminal does; allowing a site for the session stops repeat asks - [VSCode] Fixed chat links written as a full Windows path, such as C:\repo\file.ts or file:///C:/repo/file.ts, not opening the file on Windows - [VSCode] Fixed the working indicator still animating when reduced motion is turned on in your OS, in VS Code, or with the `prefersReducedMotion` setting - [VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock reading warm after the panel caught up on messages late, such as after the display was off or a remote window reconnected - [Cloud sessions] Added a status filter to the Sessions and Runners lists on a self-hosted environment's Activity tab in admin settings; you can pick several statuses at once - [Cloud sessions] Fixed every cloud session waiting for a self-hosted runner showing the same queue position; each now shows how many sessions are ahead of it - [Cloud sessions] Fixed a message you send while Claude is still replying in a cloud session jumping above that reply when it finishes; it now stays below it, including after a reload - [Claude Tag] Changed Claude in Slack to show the footer with the session link, model and cost only on its newest reply in a thread; the reply before it drops the footer - [Claude Tag] Fixed links to URLs that contain parentheses breaking in some of Claude's Slack replies and task checklists, which showed stray bracket text and opened the wrong page - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude's Slack replies drawing color swatches beside codes that only look like hex colors, such as six-digit pull request numbers - [Claude Tag] Added creating, editing and deleting workspace and channel memory files on the Activity page's Memory tab for members with the Claude Tag Admin permission - [Claude Tag] Fixed the plugin confirmation card Claude posts in a Slack channel showing a plugin's ID instead of its name - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack posting a card to remove a plugin the channel's own settings don't include; it now explains where the plugin comes from instead - [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes losing its reply when a session in a self-hosted environment moved to a new runner partway through a task - [Code Review] Fixed the Code Review check sometimes staying "in progress" on a pull request after the review finished; it now shows the review's result - [Code Review] Improved Code Review admin settings to say why a setting couldn't be saved, such as a policy restriction, instead of a generic failure message

item.title: v2.1.295
item.description: - Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through - Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done - Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers - Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load - Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a `claude -p` run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn - Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502 - Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish - Added an optional `models` list to every Claude apps gateway upstream: only the listed models are sent there, on failover too, and one `*` in an entry is a wildcard - Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway - Added advice to `claude plugin validate` when a plugin's README has no install line: it prints the line to paste and never changes the exit code, even with `--strict` - Added `upstream_request_id` to the Claude apps gateway's `inference` audit event: the request ID from Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or another upstream, for support cases - Added `$.ui.notify` for mods: raises a native notification through your own notification setting and says which channel sent it - Added children to a mod's `Button`: strings and `Text`, so a row of a list is one pressable with a chip or a dim detail inside - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors - Added a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log - Fixed every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it - Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping earlier responses when background work started another turn; each turn's response now prints when the turn ends - Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s - Fixed remote MCP connections being dropped when a server's error reply happened to contain a network error name - Fixed MCP servers that repeat a pagination cursor being asked for the same page up to 20 times at every connect - Fixed CSS, JavaScript and XML files returned by MCP tools being saved as .bin, which the Read tool refuses; font and icon files now get their own extension too - Fixed Bash tool calls failing when the model passes `command_description` instead of `description` - Fixed Claude in Chrome not applying a site deny rule written with port 80 (`host:80`) to plain `http://` pages on that host - Fixed `/plugin`'s Errors tab removing a marketplace that failed to load, and uninstalling its plugins, on Enter without asking first - Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add` reporting success for a marketplace whose name no plugin can be installed under; such an add is now refused - Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` moving a subagent to the background while an edit or shell command waited behind it, which started that call before the subagent finished - Fixed PushNotification saying a push was not sent in `claude remote-control` sessions right after a phone message, without the `/config` toggle, or when started from inside Claude Code - Fixed files sent from remote sessions being refused as "could not be vouched for" when more than 256 were sent at once - Fixed a rare failure to load managed settings at startup right after a login refresh - Fixed `/tui` exiting without a message, or with a raw system error, when Claude Code could not be started again - Fixed a link address shown as text being hidden by a colour or conceal style a reply left on, including where it wraps in a table or a question preview - Fixed Fable models listed in `availableModels` not appearing in the `/model` picker for sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway; such a model now shows its built-in row in place of a `modelPicker` row added for the same model - Fixed the Claude apps gateway's admin spend view showing a developer's old groups and group cap after their session stopped carrying groups - Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` hiding the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line. The spend limit request goes to the gateway the session is signed in to - Fixed subagents in their own linked worktree being shown the parent session's git branch, status and recent commits - Fixed Claude stopping at the end of the current tool when text typed in the prompt cancelled backgrounding with `←`; Claude now keeps working in the foreground - Fixed `--tools` and `--restricted` not applying to built-in tools that register after launch, and deprecated tool names reaching tools outside the caller's tool set - Fixed an interrupt not ending the turn until a timeout while Claude waited for an MCP server's resource list - Fixed a mod's hook being handed a deeply nested tool input cut short with no error, so a guard could pass content it never saw - Fixed Esc not stopping a self-paced `/loop` that was moved to the background with `←`; cancelling a pending wakeup now shows a notice - Fixed commands and hooks in background sessions inheriting `FORCE_COLOR=3`, which put color escape codes into the output Claude reads - Fixed `claude agents` starting a new background service as it exited when both were stopped with a session open (for example at a reboot), which could delay shutdown and restart an interrupted session - Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" in auto-mode denial notices and in the activity lists of task detail views - Fixed Bash permission checks for for-loops over glob patterns, improving permission-check accuracy - Fixed forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents delivering their results to the main conversation instead of the invoking agent - Fixed in-process agent teammates failing their first SendMessage call until they loaded the tool through tool search - Fixed Claude being told on resume that an unfinished background workflow may have been stopped by `TaskStop`, which can never be the cause - Fixed Claude not being told when you stop a long-running MCP tool call from the tasks panel or a connected client - Fixed a background session's `/loop` stopping without notice when its next wakeup came due while the session's process was down; the session now says so and Claude is told - Fixed raw terminal hyperlink bytes in a reply or a teammate's message being drawn as a clickable link with a hidden address - Fixed plugin marketplaces whose repository has large git submodules failing to add or refresh: only the submodules that hold plugin files are now fetched - Fixed the `/advisor` dialog showing a checkmark on a saved advisor model that is no longer available; it now opens on "No advisor" - Fixed the notification for an MCP tool call that moved to the background showing a shortened task id - Fixed vim mode's `~` moving the cursor past the last character of a line, so `x` after it did nothing, and `3~` running on into the next line - Fixed the cursor landing one character too far after pasting accented text copied from macOS (such as a file name) into the middle of the prompt - Fixed the terminal freezing, with ctrl+c ignored, when a response ran to tens of thousands of lines - Fixed calls a mod makes while it reloads during a plugin hooks worker restart getting past another mod's guard hook that has a `.catch`; such calls are now refused - Fixed plugins whose hooks module nests code thousands of levels deep failing to load or validate with a bare stack-overflow message - Fixed `claude plugin test` passing a `session.append` hook that removes tool call, tool result or thinking blocks that a real session keeps - Fixed Claude not being told it can resume background subagents with SendMessage after a session was killed and resumed a second time - Fixed a file being treated as already read after a Bash command such as `cat` ran without printing it - Fixed plugin options named `constructor` or `prototype` always reading as their default and never reloading the plugin when edited - Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made while `/reload-plugins` or session start was reading the mod's files - Fixed the mod hot-reloading question being asked again every turn for the whole session when it is approved without picking an answer - Fixed `/model`, `/fast` and `/output-style` saving their setting without asking a plugin's `config.set` hook - Fixed bold text being drawn faint in piped output when it directly follows dim text - Fixed replies whose quotes nest deeper every few lines freezing the terminal for seconds and using gigabytes of memory - Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made within a few milliseconds of its last reload, which left the mod on its old version until the next save - Fixed `claude mcp serve` background Bash results not naming the output file, and its tool description promising a notification that never arrives - Fixed an async SessionStart hook's unchanged context being added to the conversation again on every resume - Fixed variables a SessionStart hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool after an in-app `/resume` or `/branch` - Fixed a skill's `allowed-tools` and `effort` being dropped when the Skill tool finished before the response stream ended, which denied the skill's Bash commands in `-p` runs - Fixed a tampered cache of server-managed settings making a person's own plugin count as organization-managed on machines whose managed settings list or enable plugins - Fixed Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.x Sonnet sessions being offered tool search, which those models reject, where feature flags are unavailable - Fixed generated type files being written into a `--plugin-dir` plugin's folder in `-p` and SDK sessions; they are now written only where a mod is being developed - Fixed text with tabs or bidirectional control characters losing its end at the edge of the screen or drawing over nearby rows - Fixed `/model` saying a Max effort pick was saved as your default for new sessions; Max applies to the current session only - Fixed an async hook's JSON output being ignored when it is printed over several lines - Fixed the Read tool rejecting calls with an empty `pages` parameter instead of treating it as omitted - Fixed project-scope plugins not loading in VS Code on Windows due to drive-letter casing (anthropics/claude-code#74612) - Fixed `plugin install` and `uninstall` at project or local scope on Windows missing the install record, or adding a second one, when only the drive letter's case differs - Fixed a queued message being lost when pulled back into the prompt with `↑` or `Esc` just after `←`: prompt history now keeps it - Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the whole session when an SDK host closed its enable question before anyone answered; the question is now asked up to three times - Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being saved as typed to prompt history and to the transcript's queued-prompt records -
